description: Source code implementing size and dimension operations for Torch's lazy tensor backend, including classes SizeNode, SizeAdd, SizeMul, SizeDiv, and related functions.

classes.name: SizeNode
classes.description: Represents a size dimension node in the lazy tensor IR, capable of returning static or symbolic size information.

classes.name: SizeAdd
classes.description: Represents addition of two size dimensions.

classes.name: SizeMul
classes.description: Represents multiplication of two size dimensions.

classes.name: SizeDiv
classes.description: Represents division of two size dimensions.

methods.name: Lower
methods.description: Lowers the SizeNode to a tensor operation in the graph.

methods.name: SizeNode::getStaticValue
methods.description: Returns the static size value of the dimension if available.

methods.name: SizeNode::isSymbolic
methods.description: Checks if the size dimension is symbolic.

methods.name: SizeAdd::getStaticValue
methods.description: Returns the static sum of the two size dimensions.

methods.name: SizeAdd::isSymbolic
methods.description: Checks if either operand is symbolic.

methods.name: SizeMul::getStaticValue
methods.description: Returns the static product of the two size dimensions.

methods.name: SizeMul::isSymbolic
methods.description: Checks if either operand is symbolic.

methods.name: SizeDiv::getStaticValue
methods.description: Returns the static division result of the two size dimensions.

methods.name: SizeDiv::isSymbolic
methods.description: Checks if either operand is symbolic.
